The path consists of six distinct points connected in sequence: (67.45,49.24) → (80.19,21.11) → (55.88,0.55) → (24.51,8.49) → (20.74,44.80) → (42.70,57.61) → back to (67.45,49.24).  
That is six line segments forming a closed shape with six vertices.  
A closed shape with six straight sides is a hexagon.  

Final answer: (C)
